svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 08: Preview & Export
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Vertical strip at reader width (up to 800 px)
Preview uses saved server data, never an unsaved recovery draft (Task 9.4).
Rendering and uploading panel pictures: 2 of 3 ...
"Publish" saves, renders each panel from the saved server data,
uploads each picture with progress, then calls publish (Task 10.5).
The same step unpublishes a published episode.
It will appear on Discover and in the Reader.
Episode published. View in the Reader >
Add at least one panel before publishing.
Some panel pictures are out of date. Render them again.
Publishing again after edits is allowed (S10).
Export failed for panel 2. Try again.
2x HD export is a Premium feature. [See Premium]
Export runs in the browser: PNG with Konva and PDF
with jsPDF (D3). Files go to the device; nothing is
The 2x limit is applied in the browser only (D6).
The preview strip fills the screen width
Export and Publish actions move into a sticky
The publish checklist stays a vertical list.
Issue #17 D2: the Publish step belongs here.
Export in the browser: PNG and PDF (D3);
Preview and publish use saved server data only
